metadata.name: GetAdditionalAddressDetails
metadata.description: This API is used to get details of any additional address provided by cardholder.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: CustomerID
request_fields.description: Unique ID associated with Customer. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 121730 Condition:At least one of CustomerID/AdminNumber is required. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXX Example:12345 Condition:At least one of CustomerID/AdminNumber is required.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder/AccountHolder. *if a Specific Account Number is Inputted, then the Account Number specifc Application Details will be fetched Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404121234569 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/CustomerID/AdminNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: AdditionalAddressFirstName
children.description: First Name provided in additional address section Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AdditionalAddressMiddleName
children.description: Middle Name provided in additional address section Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AdditionalAddressLastName
children.description: Last Name provided in additional address section Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AdditionalAddressEmail
children.description: Cardholder's email ID associated with additional address details Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Format:xxx @xxx.xxx Example:abc @xyz.com Allowable Values: 300

children.name: AdditionalAddressPhoneNumber
children.description: Cardholder's Phone Number  associated with additional address details Valid Values:0-9 Example:12346678912 Allowable Values: 11

children.name: AdditionalAddressLine1
children.description: Cardholder's Address Line 1 associated with additional address details Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Example: add line 1 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AdditionalAddressLine2
children.description: Cardholder's Address Line 2 associated with additional address details Valid Values: 0-9 a-z Example: add line 2 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AdditionalAddressCity
children.description: Cardholder's City associated with additional address details Valid Values: a-z Format:xxxx Example:Kansas Allowable Values: 50

children.name: AdditionalAddressState
children.description: Cardholder's State/Province associated with additional address details Valid Values: a-z Format: xxxx Example: CA Allowable Values: 30

children.name: AdditionalAddressCountry
children.description: Cardholder's Country associated with additional address details Valid Values: a-z Format:xxxx Example:US Allowable Values: 5

children.name: AdditionalAddressPostalCode
children.description: Cardholder's PostalCode associated with additional address details Valid Values:0-9 Format:xxxx Example:123456 Allowable Values: 9

children.name: AdditionalAddressBadAddress
children.description: Flag to mark cardholder's additional detail as bad address Valid Values: true/false Example: true
